title: Sensor Type Picker
description: Eight project scenarios, six sensors, and one question that settles every one of them.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

educational.audience: Mentors helping students scope a project

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a short project scenario, the learner selects the sensor type best suited to the required measurement.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Read a scenario, click the sensor that measures what it needs, read the feedback
pedagogical.assessment: A full pass of eight with the reasoning said out loud before each click.
